Card Q&A.q: Do I or my opponent choose the card to be trashed from their hand when I activate this card's inherited effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. It activates because the Digimon is deleted by the  effect, not by battle.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s inherited effect activate when the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is deleted by  on a battled opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [On Play] 1 of your purple Digimon gains ＜Retaliation＞ until the end of your opponent's turn.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] If deleted outside of a battle, your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.
